Word of God for the Week 22/10/2026
Let’s not relent, faint nor give up but continue to pray until our joy be full & overflowing that is His advice to us in John 16:23-24.  Blessed is the one the Almighty God chooses & draws near to Himself (Psalm 65:1-4) - they shall be satisfied with His goodness & the holiness of His Temple (Psalm 36:7-10). Brethren! As we continue to dwell in His court, in asking & seeking Him in praise & worship; He will also continue to prepare a table before us even in the presence of our enemies, anointing our head with fresh oil in overflowing of His power & glory in the mighty name of Jesus Christ amen! Psalm 65:1-13; 2 Chron 15:1-15; Matt 8:23-27; Psalm 23:1-6; Isa. 25:1-12; Psalm 63:1-11
